milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Acacia wood logs are at spawn-relative (0, 1, -8), 8 blocks behind spawn (player faces south at start). Max_distance=8 requires the player to turn around and walk toward the wood. The ~8.06 actual distance (with eye height) means this is NOT pre-satisfied at spawn. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures visual confirmation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The mossy stone brick ruins are centered at (13, 2, 0), 13 blocks east of spawn. Max_distance=10 requires walking at least 3 blocks east before the target comes within range, ensuring deliberate navigation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Brown stained glass panes are on the west wall of the brown bedroom at (-9, 2, 10). Distance from spawn is ~13.5 blocks. Max_distance=8 requires close approach to the bedroom exterior to identify the distinctive windows.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Blue wool blocks flank the blue bedroom doorway; target is the midpoint at (-6, 2, -8). Distance from spawn is ~10 blocks. Max_distance=8 requires deliberate navigation to the north-west area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown bed is inside the fully enclosed brown bedroom at (-7, 1, 11). Max_distance=5 requires the player to actually enter the room through the single doorway at (-6, 1, 8), since the bed is ~3 blocks from the door and walls block line-of-sight from outside.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The light blue bed is inside the fully enclosed blue bedroom at (-7, 1, -11). Max_distance=5 requires actual room entry through the wool-flanked doorway at (-6, 1, -8), since the bed is ~3 blocks from the door inside the enclosed space.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Stone stairs begin at (12, 0, 0) inside the enclosed mossy ruins. Max_distance=6 requires the player to enter the ruins through the entrance at (10, 2, 0) and approach the staircase. The stairs are not visible from outside the enclosed structure.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden_axe results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must harvest acacia_wood, convert to planks, then sticks, then craft the axe at the crafting table. No wooden_axe exists in starting inventory, so its presence confirms successful multi-step crafting.

Uses inventory_has + position_near_with_facing as compound verification. The player must break the barrel at (-8, 1, 11), carry it to the underground anvil at (16, -3, 0), rename it in the anvil GUI, and retrieve it. inventory_has confirms the barrel was obtained as an item. position_near_with_facing toward the anvil (max_distance=3) confirms the player physically reached the workshop. Together these verify the full rename workflow was completed — the strongest verification possible without NBT/custom-name checking.

Uses inventory_has + position_near_with_facing as compound verification. The player must break the shulker box at (-8, 1, -11), carry it to the underground anvil at (16, -3, 0), rename it in the anvil GUI, and retrieve it. inventory_has confirms the shulker_box was obtained. position_near_with_facing toward the anvil (max_distance=3) confirms the player reached the workshop. This compound rule verifies the complete physical workflow required for renaming.
